newsitem.title: TURKEY: Koc to sell 12.6 pct Otosan stake to partner Ford.
newsitem.headline: Koc to sell 12.6 pct Otosan stake to partner Ford.

text.p: Leading Turkish industrial conglomerate Koc group has agreed to sell its 12.6 percent stake in vehicle producer Otosan to the Ford Motor Company, a Koc subsidiary said on Wednesday.

Ford and Koc Holding had agreed late last year to equalise their stakes in their joint venture Otosan. Koc group's total stake is 53.86 percent while Ford's is 30 percent in Otosan's 1,392.5 billion lira capital.

"The value of the 12.6 percent stake to be transferred has been accepted by the partners at $48 million and will be finalised by a partnership and share transfer agreement to be signed in the coming days," said Koc's casting unit Doktas in a statement.
It said the 12.6 percent stake corresponded to 175.4 billion lira of Otosan's capital. The sale price per 1,000 lira nominal-valued share was 27.366 cents, it added.
Transfer of shares to Ford are expected to be completed by July 24 after approval by the Treasury's foreign investment directorate.
Doktas and Koc's durables producing arm, Arcelik, announced earlier on Wednesday they would sell their small Otosan stakes to Ford.

Arcelik said it would sell 7,684,908 shares, or 1.38 percent of Otosan's capital for $5.26 million. Doktas said it would sell 14,035,078 shares, or 2.52 percent of Otosan's capital, for $9.60 million.
Both companies said they would use gains from the sale to increase capital. Arcelik expects a 746.25 billion lira profit and Doktas awaits a 1.37 trillion lira profit at current lira/dollar rates.
After the sale, Doktas will still hold a 0.27 percent stake in Otosan.
